phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / Phase A — QSA source-coverage audit
purpose: Determine which canonical RMD bilateral accounting cells can be populated from exact ECB QSA observations or exact algebraic sector aggregation before changing benchmark values or statuses.

scope.benchmark_flow_aggregation: sum of four definitionally identical quarterly transactions

F.meaning: Financial corporations excluding the central bank
F.derivation: Exact additive subtraction only, using definitionally identical QSA series. If any required component is absent, the canonical cell remains unresolved.

X.encoding_rule: Represent resident-vs-rest-of-world positions through counterpart area W1 with counterpart sector S1 on the resident reference-sector side. Do not invent an S2 bilateral series when the national QSA WTWTW boundary is encoded by counterpart area.

canonical_orientation.domestic_holder_domestic_issuer: asset-side QSA series with reference sector = holder and counterpart sector = issuer; liability-side mirror is an independent reconciliation check
canonical_orientation.resident_holder_rest_of_world_issuer: resident holder asset-side QSA series with counterpart area W1 and counterpart sector S1
canonical_orientation.rest_of_world_holder_resident_issuer: resident issuer liability-side QSA series with counterpart area W1 and counterpart sector S1
canonical_orientation.rest_of_world_holder_rest_of_world_issue: outside the Romanian national-accounts bilateral boundary; candidate for NOT_APPLICABLE only after boundary audit, not changed in this phase

promotion_gate_after_audit: exact series definition matches the canonical holder, issuer, instrument, measure, maturity, consolidation, valuation, currency and unit
required 2025 observation or all four quarterly transactions exist and are finite
all exact-derivation components exist when a composite sector is used
asset/liability mirror residual is within the preregistered tolerance when both sides are available
raw source payload and normalized audit output receive provenance hashes before any value is committed to the benchmark
